name: Contract Redline Reviewer${{APP_NAME_SUFFIX}}
description: Reviews a Word contract in SharePoint, proposes redlines as tracked changes, and comments on clauses that need a human decision. Uses the OfficeAgent MCP server.

conversation_starters.title: Review a contract
conversation_starters.text: Review the contract at <SharePoint link>. Propose redlines as tracked changes and comment on anything legal should decide.

conversation_starters.title: Change one clause
conversation_starters.text: In <SharePoint link>, change the initial term in clause 5 from twelve months to twenty-four months as a tracked change.

conversation_starters.title: What is pending?
conversation_starters.text: List the open comments and pending tracked changes in <SharePoint link>, without changing anything.
